name: Haiku macro/sector rotation
strategy: Rate-hike acceleration positions with financials prominence and energy moderation, maintaining inflation hedge via crypto and quality defensives amid breadth concerns.
reassessment_note: Federal Reserve surprised with rate hike in September 2026 and signaled additional hikes before 2027 pause, confirming rate-hiking cycle thesis. However, energy sector (32% YTD, earnings contraction forecast for 2027) has already captured geopolitical premium; current book down 495 bps vs SPY reflects misallocation. Repositioned to maximize rate benefits through expanded financials allocation (+5% to 27% for wider net interest margins and lending spreads) while moderating extended energy exposure (-11% to 15%). Added healthcare for quality defensive hedge (+12%, showing +2.47% recent strength) and low-volatility positioning (+9%) to address market breadth concerns at all-time highs. Maintained crypto inflation hedge (+10%) and core SPY allocation (+22%). Reduced cash from 15% to 5% for fuller deployment amid rate-hike certainty.

positions.thesis: Financials sector benefits from wider net interest margins and lending spreads as Federal Reserve executes rate-hiking cycle through 2026; positioned for continued policy tightening with high dividend yield (>3%) supporting core allocation and responsive to September rate hike.

Energy sector maintains exposure to sustained geopolitical premium (Iran conflict, Strait of Hormuz tensions, crude at $108/bbl after Trump peace rejection) but position reduced from 26% after 32% year-to-date returns and forecast 5% earnings contraction in 2027; de-risking extended valuation while preserving geopolitical upside.

Core broad market allocation providing diversification and participation in S&P 500's rate-driven leadership; increased from 17% to maintain tactical flexibility and benefit from higher-rate environment with full market exposure.

Healthcare sector provides defensive quality exposure with lower beta to rate cycle; showing strength (+2.47% recent performance) and benefits from secular aging demographic trends resilient to monetary policy environment.

Bitcoin maintained as macro hedge against inflation and currency debasement in elevated-rate environment; long-term store of value amid geopolitical uncertainty and persistent inflation (PCE >3% all 2026).

Invesco S&P 500 Low Volatility ETF provides downside protection given market breadth deterioration concerns and S&P 500 near all-time highs; quality factor positioning with demonstrated 3.62% September performance captures defensive positioning at valuation risk.
